$comment: Your bullet pool, saved as data/bullet-library.json in your workspace. `/jobe onboard` fills it from your own evidence. It starts EMPTY on purpose: until you add bullets nothing is assumed about your skills, and every posting is scored neutrally. Layout: one top level list per role you have held, under a role key of your choosing (current, prior1, prior2 and so on are only a convention), plus a selectedProjects list for work outside a job. companyKeyMap maps each company string in data/resume-baseline.json experience[].company to its role key; defaultBulletCounts in the baseline and bulletCounts in a per posting spec use the same keys. Bullet shape: { "id": "<unique id>", "keywords": ["<skill or method this bullet proves>"], "text": "<the bullet as it should read on a resume>", "archetypes": ["<optional bucket name from data/archetypes.json>"], "studyGroup": "<optional label; two bullets with the same label never appear on one resume>" }. A selectedProjects entry also takes "name", the project name shown on the resume. keywords matter: they are how Jobe learns which skills you can prove, so use the words a job description would use. Every bullet must trace to an entry in your reference.md. Keys that start with $ are notes and are ignored.

$examples.$comment: Two unrelated professions, to show the shape only. Neither is a default and none of this text is yours to use. Do not copy these bullets.
